engine: crownd/finest's hero — a full-bleed HERO whose BACKGROUND is a crossfading SLIDESHOW that mixes VIDEO clips and RENDER stills, while a big serif WORDMARK stays FIXED and persistent over all of them (the title never moves or swaps; only the media behind it rotates). Video slides autoplay muted+loop while active and pause when off (no currentTime scrub). A slow Ken-Burns on the active media gives it life. Harvested from D_finest (F1: drone video -> building render -> pool render, 'finest' fixed on top).

measured_teardown.move: slides are stacked full-bleed; the active one is opacity 1, the rest 0 (crossfade over `fade` ms). Auto-advances every `interval` ms (pauses on hover if hoverPause, and when the hero is off-screen via IntersectionObserver). A video slide calls play() on activate and pause() on deactivate (no currentTime touch — loop handles repeat) (battery/perf). The active media's inner .hvr-frame does a slow scale 1.02 -> 1.12 ken-burns over ~6s. The .hvr-title layer sits ABOVE all media (z) and never animates with the rotation.
measured_teardown.cited: finest hero: a big serif 'finest' wordmark centred and fixed, with the background crossfading drone aerial video -> building render -> pool/terrace render; persistent nav + a bottom search-pill.

interval.what: time each slide holds before auto-advancing.

kenburns.what: slow scale on the active media (1.02 -> 1.12 over ~6s) for life; off for a static bg.

hoverPause.what: pause auto-advance while the pointer is over the hero.

entry: HeroVideoRenderRotator.create(target, opts) -> { go(i), next(), index(), count, play(), stop(), destroy }. target = .hvr-stage > .hvr-media(.hvr-slide (each: .hvr-frame > img | video) x N) + .hvr-title(.mark) + optional .hvr-dot list. Videos are auto-set muted+loop+playsinline.
law: opacity (crossfade) + transform scale (ken-burns) only; GPU; NO mix-blend over the media; NO WebGL; videos muted+playsinline+loop, play only while active AND on-screen (IntersectionObserver-gated); reduced-motion -> no auto-advance, no ken-burns, first slide shown, video paused. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a hero rotator). The title is a fixed layer, never part of the rotation.
gate_mode: triggered/auto rotator (not scroll). Verify: exactly one slide active (opacity 1) at a time; the video slide PLAYS when active and PAUSES when off (battery); the title is fixed/persistent across all slides; dots track the index. GATE-BLINDSPOT: video playback is not jank — probe jank during the CROSSFADES (force slide changes), not steady video. A static screenshot only shows one slide; verify the rotation + video play/pause in code.
proven: lab: 5 slides on OUR QUADRO media (clip-river-lite.webm video + aerial/day-front/terrace/night renders) with a fixed 'finest' serif wordmark. Measured live: exactly 1 slide active (opacity 1, rest 0); the video slide (idx 0) playing=true when active, paused when on a render slide, resumes on return; title fixed across all; no dots in finest (optional); clip loads (200, 10.9MB). Screenshot (aerial render active): the 'finest' italic serif centred + persistent over the QUADRO render, nav + bottom search-pill, NO dots (matches finest hero exactly). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 6 forced crossfades): 6/333 long frames (1.8%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. Serif stand-in = Playfair Display italic (Canela / PP-Editorial class).
